_span_note: span = the host's agent vmPortSpan, default 6: the CLI tries port .. port+span-1 with the host's token and uses the one that answers. Space the hosts' ports at least a span apart; span 1 pins a host to its port.

zurich.token: the cmdapi token of this host, from its relay.env CMDAPI_TOKEN

office.token: a different token, this host's own
